entities.name: GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to the network to indicate that reallocation of a GUTI has taken place.

entities.name: Protocol discriminator
entities.description: Identifies the protocol type for the message.

entities.name: Security header type
entities.description: Specifies the security header format applied to the message.

entities.name: GUTI reallocation complete message identity
entities.description: Identifies the message type as GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE.

entities.name: GUTI reallocation
entities.description: Procedure where the network assigns a new GUTI to the UE and the UE confirms completion.

relations.description: The GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE message includes the Protocol discriminator IE.
The GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE message includes the Security header type IE.
The GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE message includes its message identity IE.
The GUTI reallocation procedure includes the UE sending the GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE message.
